i1.title: Police Amber Gold Eau de Toilette 100ml Gift Set with 125ml Body Lotion

It is an oriental floral fragrance: bitter orange and saffron open bright and spicy, a heart of amber, jasmine and magnolia glows warm and feminine, and it settles onto akigalawood, amberwood and oakmoss.

  • Police Amber Gold Body Lotion 125ml

  • Concentration: Eau de Toilette
  • Contents: Police Amber Gold Eau de Toilette 100ml + Police Amber Gold Body Lotion 125ml
  • Scent profile: Oriental · Floral

  • A warm amber, jasmine and magnolia heart
  • A rich akigalawood and oakmoss base
  • A matching body lotion to layer the scent

Bitter orange and saffron first, then amber, jasmine and magnolia, finishing with akigalawood, amberwood and oakmoss.
